routes.name: Amber Road, Aquileia to the Baltic
citations: Pliny the Elder, Natural History, trans. J. Bostock and H. T. Riley (London: Bohn, 1855-1857) [public domain], book 37.11 (45)
routes.notes: Pliny reports that a Roman knight travelled about 600 miles from Carnuntum to the Baltic coast to buy amber under Nero. Our line runs Aquileia, Emona, Poetovio, Savaria, Carnuntum, Calisia to the coast.
routes.goods_source: general history; not from a cargo manifest
